# Harry HR

> > Harry HR is a comprehensive employee experience platform designed to solve critical HR challenges like turnover and engagement through integrated solutions for recognition, communication, feedback, learning, and analytics.

Harry HR is a European-based HR software platform offering a suite of integrated solutions for employee engagement, experience, and development. The platform combines recognition, internal communication, pulse surveys, learning, self-service, knowledge management, and HR analytics to help organizations build stronger workplace cultures and reduce employee turnover.

## Key Topics

- Employee Experience Platform
- Employee Engagement
- Spark Moments (Recognition & Rewards)
- Grow Station (Learning & Onboarding)
- SatisQuestions (Pulse Surveys)
- Company Topics (Internal Communication)
- Service Spot (Self-Service)
- Brain Base (Knowledge Base)
- HR Analytics
- Turnover Reduction
- GDPR Compliance
- Workplace Culture
- Employee Feedback
- Peer Recognition
- Europe

## Core Platform Solutions

- [Harry HR Platform](https://harryhr.com): Harry HR Employee Experience Platform solving turnover, engagement, and HR process challenges.
- [Spark Moments](https://harryhr.com/solutions/spark-moments): Employee recognition and rewards platform with Spark Coins for engagement and peer recognition.
- [Grow Station](https://harryhr.com/solutions/learning-onboarding-platform-employees): Learning and onboarding platform with gamified e-learning for employee development.
- [SatisQuestions](https://harryhr.com/solutions/satisquestions): Pulse survey and employee feedback system with emoji responses for quick insights.
- [Company Topics](https://harryhr.com/solutions/company-topics): Internal communication platform for targeted messaging and team alignment.

## Employee Enablement & Collaboration

- [Service Spot](https://harryhr.com/solutions/employee-self-service-platform): Employee self-service platform automating HR, IT, and facilities requests.
- [Brain Base](https://harryhr.com/solutions/internal-social-knowledge-base-employees): Internal social knowledge base for employee collaboration and knowledge sharing.

## Analytics & Insights

- [HR Analytics Dashboard](https://harryhr.com/solutions/data-driven-iso-30414-hr-dashboard): ISO 30414-compliant HR analytics dashboard for data-driven HR insights and compliance.
